NONE: › used to express surprise or anger
喲，嗨，哎呀（表示驚訝或生氣）

NONE: A2 used to make a suggestion

example: Why don't you come with us?
你為什麼不跟我們一起來呢？

NONE: › said when you want to know why someone would do something himself or herself when that person already pays someone else to do it
既然花錢找人代勞了，為何還親自動手？
B1 used to make a suggestion or to express agreement
（表示建議或同意）為甚麼不（呢）?

example: Why not use my car? You'll fit more in.
為甚麼不用我的車呢？能裝更多東西。
